about: OpenAI Codex hooks (CLI; app and IDE extension share the same core). Follows the default conventions; turn_id is shared by steered messages and their Stop.

requires.name: Codex
requires.needs: hooks whose Stop event carries last_assistant_message

install.after: Codex runs a new or changed hook only after you trust it: Settings > Hooks > Trust all (desktop app or VS Code extension), or /hooks in the CLI.
